The dotted line graphic on the cover appears slightly 'painted on' rather than physically printed or embossed. The dots vary irregularly in size and spacing in a way that suggests generative noise rather than a precise mechanical printing process.

The white area representing pages at the top lacks distinct sheet separation. It appears as a single solid white wedge rather than stacked paper edges, though this is minor and could be due to resolution.
